newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Electric to raise $400 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Israel Electric to raise $400 mln in bonds.

text.p: The government-owned Israel Electric Corp is planning to raise about $400 million in bond issues in the next six months, company sources said on Thursday.
"The plan calls for bond offerings to take place initially in the United States and then in Europe," a company official said.
The electric company, the first Israeli government company to sell bonds in the United States and in Europe, is being advised by Lehman Brothers and Salomon Brothers.
The company official added that an exact timetable and amounts of the two separate offerings would be determined in the weeks ahead in consultation with the company's advisers.

The decision is part of a plan to raise funds to cover some of the financing costs of its development programme in the coming years. The electric company will need about $1.5 billion annually over the next five years to build power plants and other infrastructure.
